# Pandect

> Pandect is a free website for people studying for the LSAT. It has LSAT-style Logical Reasoning and Reading Comprehension practice questions (written in the style of the LSAT; they are not official LSAT questions), drills by question type, timed 35-minute sections, and progress tracking by question type.

Practicing needs a free account (email and password). Everything except the home and About pages is behind sign-in.

## What you get

- Drills by question type: Flaw, Strengthen, Necessary Assumption and the other Logical Reasoning types, plus Reading Comprehension, each in its own set, with an explanation after every answer.
- Timed sections: Logical Reasoning or Reading Comprehension, 35 minutes, like a section on test day.
- Progress: accuracy by question type, and the missed questions, ready to redo.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pandectprep.pages.dev/): what Pandect is, how it works, and common questions.
- [About](https://pandectprep.pages.dev/about): the LSAT's sections at a glance and how the question bank is built.

LSAT is a registered trademark of the Law School Admission Council, which is not affiliated with Pandect.
